findings.highlight: Sakura who had collapsed near the front door
findings.evidenceJa: 門の近くで倒れていた桜
findings.governingReading: 門 near the property boundary is distinct from the interior house doorway; her shoes remain at the entrance while she collapsed outside.
findings.explanation: The outdoor gate becomes the front door.

findings.evidenceJa: 思考が思考を拒絶している
findings.governingReading: 思考が思考を拒絶 describes thinking refusing the attempt to think, immediately followed by a missing interval his body remembers.
findings.explanation: Thought refusing thought becomes mutually contradictory thoughts.

findings.highlight: Sakura sees my face and makes a slightly pained sigh.
findings.evidenceJa: 少し苦しげな息遣いで桜は言った
findings.governingReading: 苦しげな息遣いで桜は言った gives the breathing accompanying her just-spoken greeting.
findings.explanation: Speaking with labored breathing becomes making a pained sigh.

findings.highlight: Sakura does her best to make eye contact from where she's lying.
findings.evidenceJa: 横になった桜と視線をできるだけ合わせる
findings.governingReading: The continuing first-person subject takes a chair and aligns his gaze with the lying Sakura as much as possible.
findings.explanation: He tries to meet Sakura’s gaze becomes her effort to make eye contact.

findings.highlight: there's nothing to worry about as long as I'm sleeping enough
findings.evidenceJa: 寝ている分にはなんの心配もいらない
findings.governingReading: 寝ている分には restricts safety to staying recumbent/resting.
findings.explanation: No concern while lying down becomes no concern provided she sleeps enough.

findings.highlight: so I'll have to put up with it.
findings.evidenceJa: そうであってもらわないと困る
findings.governingReading: そうであってもらわないと困る says it is necessary that the sufficient-energy answer actually hold.
findings.explanation: Her magical-energy adequacy must be true becomes putting up with his embarrassment.

findings.highlight: She wants to at least live life, even if she can't do anything about our situation.
findings.evidenceJa: せめて今まで通りの間桐桜であろうとする
findings.governingReading: 今まで通りの間桐桜であろうとする ties her domestic role to preserving her familiar self when powerless.
findings.explanation: Trying to remain the Sakura she has always been becomes at least living life.

findings.highlight: When a sick person doesn't rest, they'll just get sicker.
findings.evidenceJa: 病人は病人らしく休まないと損だぞ
findings.governingReading: 休まないと損 plays into the joke that later she will regret not taking rest before he gives her all meals.
findings.explanation: Losing out by not resting becomes necessarily getting sicker.

findings.evidenceJa: 真っ先にごはんを食べてくださいね
findings.governingReading: Sakura asks him to give eating her cooking first priority once she recovers.
findings.explanation: The request loses 'first thing' after recovery. The promise to eat Sakura's cooking and her return to the kitchen remain.

findings.evidenceJa: 振り向かずに声をあげる
findings.governingReading: He puts his hand on the knob and speaks without looking back, managing his natural delivery before asking about collapse.
findings.explanation: A deliberate question without turning becomes a newly occurring thought.

findings.highlight: After a slight pause, she answers.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜はわずかに息を飲んだあと
findings.governingReading: 息を飲んだ gives an involuntary intake/catch of breath before her bright natural reply.
findings.explanation: Her slight catch of breath becomes an ordinary pause.
